name: cc-image-view
description: Shows the images Claude's replies and tool results refer to, inline in the terminal transcript

showImages.title: Show images
showImages.description: Draw the images that replies and tool results refer to under them. Off leaves the transcript as text; /img <path> still shows one on request. /img off and /img on switch this too.

autoLoadRemoteImages.title: Auto-load remote images
autoLoadRemoteImages.description: Fetch http(s) image URLs that appear in Claude's replies without asking. Off by default: a reply shaped by a prompt injection can carry data out in an image URL, and fetching it sends that data.
